entities.summary: Gerald William Wiesner is a Canadian prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He was ordained bishop of the Diocese of Prince George on February 22, 1993 and retired on January 3, 2013. Stephen Arthur Jensen succeeded him as the new bishop of Prince George.
